detail.image: Illustrative product-family image; not a supplier sample or shipment photograph.
detail.basis: Listed grades identify the sourcing range, not guaranteed nutrient minima. N-P-K expresses nitrogen (N), phosphate as P₂O₅ and potassium as K₂O. Guaranteed values, analytical basis and methods are confirmed in the agreed supplier specification.
detail.packingText: Tell us your preferred packing and handling requirements. Available bag weights, big bags or bulk options, marking, minimum order quantity and delivery timing are confirmed with the selected supply source before quotation.
detail.docsText: The document set is agreed for the product and destination: technical data sheet (TDS), safety data sheet (SDS) where applicable, and certificate of analysis (COA) for the actual shipment. Representative analyses are identified as such. Inspection by an independent provider may be coordinated when agreed.
detail.complianceText: Applicable EU and destination-market requirements are assessed for the selected product and supply route. REACH status, CE marking or any other compliance claim is supported by the relevant product documents before it is made.
detail.ctaText: Send the quantity, destination, preferred packing and delivery window. The product and grade will be carried into your enquiry.
detail.gradeText: Confirm the exact product identity, nutrient minima and test methods in the supplier TDS. The shipment COA reports results against the agreed limits.
detail.phosphorusText: State total, available and water-soluble P₂O₅ separately, including extraction method and reporting basis. These values are not interchangeable.
detail.nitrogenText: Confirm total nitrogen and the relevant forms; distinguish nitrate, ammoniacal and urea nitrogen where applicable.
detail.potassiumText: Confirm the declared K₂O equivalent and its water-soluble fraction. K₂O and elemental potassium are different reporting bases.
detail.physicalText: Confirm moisture, particle-size distribution and product form. For granules, agree strength and fines limits where needed.
detail.metalsText: Agree limits and test methods for the destination. Distinguish mg/kg of product from mg/kg of P₂O₅, and state the moisture basis.
detail.solubleText: Confirm water solubility, insoluble matter and purity where relevant. State temperature, solution concentration and units for measured properties.
detail.chlorideText: Request a product-specific chloride limit and analysis when relevant to the application; no absolute chloride-free guarantee is assumed.
detail.biuretText: Confirm the biuret limit for the intended use in the selected urea specification.
detail.acidityText: Confirm free acidity and solution pH with test concentration and temperature; suitability depends on the intended formulation and equipment.
detail.magnesiumText: Confirm magnesium as Mg or MgO with the reporting basis explicitly stated. Verify the hexahydrate identity and its nitrogen declaration.
detail.traceText: Declare each included element, concentration and chemical form. Confirm total, water-soluble and chelated fractions where relevant.
detail.chelateText: Confirm chelating agent, chelated fraction and stability range. For Fe-EDDHA, specify the ortho-ortho isomer fraction; do not infer it from total Fe alone.
detail.compositionText: Confirm the complete formulation, ingredient forms and nutrient declaration in the manufacturer specification.
detail.identityText: The commercial grade is retained. The full technical name and composition must be confirmed by the selected manufacturer before an offer is finalized.
detail.use.phosphates: Phosphate raw materials for fertilizer manufacture and formulation. Direct soil application is assessed only where product reactivity, soil conditions and destination rules support it.
detail.use.processed: Phosphate nutrition and fertilizer blending, matched to the declared nutrient fractions, crop programme and product form. Application method and dose require appropriate agronomic advice.
detail.use.nitrogen: Nitrogen nutrition and compatible fertilizer programmes. Product form, biuret level and handling requirements are matched to the intended use.
detail.use.water-soluble: Fertigation and other soluble-nutrition programmes where the selected product is suitable. Water quality, solution concentration, mixing compatibility and application method must be checked for the intended use.
detail.use.micronutrients: Targeted micronutrient supply or formulation, based on the actual chemical form and concentration. Product selection and application rate depend on the crop, water and soil conditions.
detail.rawBasis: These materials are assessed on request. The source specification must identify the material, composition, analytical basis, test methods and intended use. A chemical name or formula does not establish purity, suitability, registration or current availability.
detail.rawCompositionText: Confirm the exact material, mineral or chemical composition, purity and declared analytical basis against the manufacturer specification.
detail.calciumMagnesiumText: State which components are measured and whether results are reported as elements, oxides or carbonates. Confirm the mineral composition and relevant methods; these reporting bases are not interchangeable.
detail.neutralisationText: Where agricultural liming use is proposed, confirm the applicable neutralising value, reactivity, fineness and destination requirements. Intended use must be supported by the specific product documentation.
detail.acidConcentrationText: State whether concentration is expressed as H₃PO₄ or P₂O₅ equivalent, and identify the mass basis, density and reference temperature where relevant. Do not treat H₃PO₄ and P₂O₅ percentages as the same value.
detail.rawImpuritiesText: Agree the relevant impurity limits and analytical methods for the intended use and destination. A representative analysis does not replace the actual shipment analysis.
detail.liquidText: Confirm physical form, density and any relevant handling or storage conditions in the manufacturer technical and safety documentation.
detail.compatibilityText: Identify the host fertilizer, formulation, granule properties, process and storage conditions. Compatibility must be reviewed for the specific combination.
detail.doseText: Treatment rate and application method are specified by the additive manufacturer and validated for the actual process. No universal dosage is assumed.
detail.performanceText: Agree measurable caking, dust or handling performance criteria and the trial conditions. Results for one fertilizer or storage environment do not establish performance for another.
detail.packingRaw: Confirm the physical form and compatible packaging or bulk transport arrangement, container size, marking, handling requirements, minimum order and delivery window with the selected source. Liquid and solid materials require product-specific arrangements.
detail.use.raw-materials: Mineral, chemical and formulation inputs are assessed against the buyer’s stated end use. Industrial and agricultural grades are not automatically interchangeable; suitability and any agricultural application require the relevant product documentation and qualified advice.
detail.identity.erp: Rock phosphate is a mineral raw material, not a pure chemical compound. Specify total P₂O₅, origin and particle size. BPL is a different reporting basis; it must not be read as percent P₂O₅.
detail.identity.grp: Granular rock phosphate (GRP) describes the physical form of phosphate rock. Granulation alone does not establish water solubility or make the material superphosphate.
detail.identity.grp-s: A phosphate-rock formulation with sulfur and/or additives. Declare P₂O₅ and sulfur separately, identify elemental sulfur or sulfate, and state whether sulfur is reported as S or SO₃.
detail.identity.low-cadmium: Low cadmium is an analytical requirement, not a distinct chemical compound or a fixed phosphorus grade. State the numerical Cd limit, method, moisture basis and units; mg/kg of product and mg/kg of P₂O₅ are not equivalent.
detail.identity.ssp: Granular single superphosphate (GSSP): a phosphate fertilizer containing monocalcium phosphate and calcium sulfate. The listed 17% P₂O₅ requires a stated extraction and reporting basis; calcium and sulfur contents are declared separately.
detail.identity.ssp19: Granular single superphosphate (GSSP): a phosphate fertilizer containing monocalcium phosphate and calcium sulfate. The listed 19% P₂O₅ requires a stated extraction and reporting basis; it is a separate grade from GSSP 17% and GSP 20%.
detail.identity.gsp: GSP 20% is retained as a commercial designation for a granular phosphatic fertilizer. The abbreviation and percentage alone do not establish its chemical composition or P₂O₅ solubility. Confirm the manufacturer's full product identity before quotation.
detail.identity.dsp: Double superphosphate (DSP), listed at 36% P₂O₅. Confirm the exact manufacturer specification and distinguish total, extractable and water-soluble P₂O₅. DSP fertilizer must not be confused with disodium phosphate, which may use the same abbreviation in chemical trade.
detail.identity.tsp: Triple superphosphate (TSP) is a concentrated phosphate fertilizer based mainly on monocalcium phosphate. The listed 0-46-0 is an N-P₂O₅-K₂O grade. It is not trisodium phosphate, another chemical sometimes abbreviated TSP.
detail.identity.dap: Diammonium hydrogen phosphate, commonly diammonium phosphate (DAP), (NH₄)₂HPO₄. The listed 18-46-0 refers to N, P₂O₅ and K₂O; nitrogen is ammoniacal. The P₂O₅ extraction basis belongs in the product specification.
detail.identity.map: Granular ammophos marketed as MAP grade 10-46-0 is an ammonium-phosphate fertilizer. It may contain both NH₄H₂PO₄ and (NH₄)₂HPO₄; do not describe the commercial material as pure monoammonium phosphate or substitute a soluble MAP 12-61-0 specification.
detail.identity.npk-granular: A granular fertilizer supplying nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium. State the N-P₂O₅-K₂O grade and whether the product is a manufactured compound or a physical bulk blend; the grade alone does not establish the manufacturing route.
detail.identity.urea: Urea, also called carbamide, CO(NH₂)₂. The listed 46% is nitrogen as N, not urea purity. Nitrogen is in the urea form; biuret, moisture and particle-size limits require separate declarations.
detail.identity.mkp: Potassium dihydrogen phosphate, commonly monopotassium phosphate (MKP), KH₂PO₄. The trade grade 0-52-34 is not a universal guarantee of minimum 52% P₂O₅ and 34% K₂O. State the agreed minima, moisture basis and chloride limit from the selected TDS.
detail.identity.up: Urea phosphate (UP), CO(NH₂)₂·H₃PO₄, is the urea-phosphoric acid adduct, not monoammonium phosphate. The listed 17-44-0 expresses N-P₂O₅-K₂O. Specify nitrogen form, water-soluble P₂O₅ and the concentration and temperature of any pH measurement.
detail.identity.nop: Potassium nitrate (KNO₃), also nitrate of potash (NOP). The listed 13-0-46 expresses N-P₂O₅-K₂O, with nitrogen in nitrate form. NOP is different from potassium chloride (MOP); a product-specific chloride limit is still required.
detail.identity.magnesium: Magnesium nitrate hexahydrate, Mg(NO₃)₂·6H₂O. The six waters of crystallisation are part of the chemical identity. Magnesium as Mg and magnesium as MgO are different reporting bases; do not transfer an anhydrous-salt specification to this material.
detail.identity.npk-202020: Water-soluble NPK formulation with a listed N-P₂O₅-K₂O grade of 20-20-20. TE means trace elements; it does not identify which elements, their concentrations or their chelated fractions. These require a separate declaration.
detail.identity.npk-105210: Water-soluble NPK formulation with a listed N-P₂O₅-K₂O grade of 10-52-10. TE means trace elements; specify each element and form. This formulation is not MAP or MKP, even though it also has a high phosphate grade.
detail.identity.npk-150530: Water-soluble NPK formulation with a listed N-P₂O₅-K₂O grade of 15-5-30. Declare trace elements individually and identify the potassium source where chloride sensitivity matters. The grade does not establish chloride content.
detail.identity.iron: Iron chelated with EDDHA, listed at 6% Fe by mass. The percentage refers to iron, not the amount of EDDHA. Declare water-soluble iron, chelated iron and iron chelated by the ortho-ortho isomer separately, with the basis for each percentage.
detail.identity.zinc: Zinc chelated with EDTA, listed at 15% Zn by mass. The percentage refers to zinc, not EDTA. Verify total, water-soluble and chelated zinc and the declared pH stability range for the actual formulation.
detail.identity.manganese: Manganese nutrition products: Mn identifies the nutrient, not the chemical product. Specify the salt or chelate, hydration where relevant, and manganese content as elemental Mn before selecting a grade.
detail.identity.boron: Boron nutrition products: B is an elemental nutrient declaration. Boric acid, borate salts and liquid formulations are different products; identify the actual compound and declare boron content as B.
detail.identity.copper: Copper nutrition products: specify the actual salt or chelate and declare elemental Cu. Chemical form, hydration and solubility must be identified; the symbol Cu alone is not a fertilizer specification.
detail.identity.molybdenum: Molybdenum nutrition products: specify the actual molybdate salt or formulation and declare elemental Mo. Counter-ion, hydration and concentration depend on the selected material.
detail.identity.specialty: A sourcing category, not a single compound or standard formula. Identify the intended function, ingredients and nutrient forms before assigning a product name, specification or application claim.
detail.identity.dolomite: Dolomite is a calcium-magnesium carbonate mineral with ideal formula CaMg(CO₃)₂. Natural rock may contain other minerals. CaO and MgO analytical equivalents do not mean the material is quicklime or calcined dolomite.
detail.identity.calcium-carbonate: Calcium carbonate, CaCO₃. Distinguish the compound assay from elemental Ca or CaO equivalent, and identify ground or precipitated material where relevant. A chemical formula does not establish fineness, neutralising value or agricultural suitability.
detail.identity.phosphoric-acid: Orthophosphoric acid, H₃PO₄. Concentration as H₃PO₄ is different from P₂O₅ equivalent. State mass percent and acid grade; density, solids, fluoride and relevant metals require product-specific limits and test conditions.
detail.identity.potassium-chloride: Potassium chloride, KCl, commonly muriate of potash (MOP) in fertilizer trade. K₂O equivalent is a nutrient reporting convention, not KCl purity. This material contains chloride by composition; it is not potassium nitrate (NOP) or potassium sulfate (SOP).
detail.identity.fertilizer-additives: Fertilizer additives and anti-caking agents are product-specific formulations, not a single chemical or nutrient grade. Define composition, carrier, compatible fertilizer, application conditions and measurable performance; no universal dosage or effectiveness is implied.
